title: Monotonicity of event probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $P,Q\subseteq\Omega$ satisfy $P\subseteq Q$. Then the probability assigned by $p$ to $P$ is at most the probability assigned to $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
